Cŏtўs, tyis (acc. -tȳn, rarely -tym; abl. -tye), and Cŏtus, i, m., = Κότυς,
the name of several Thracian princes.
A ruler of the coast of Thrace B. C. 382-356, son-in-law of Iphicrates, ; ; , ext. 7.—
Cotys II., king of the Odrysæ, an ally of Perseus in his war against Rome, ; ; ; .—
Cotys III., king of the Odrysæ, ; ; ; .—
Cotys V., grandson of III., sqq.; 4, 5.—
A brother of Mithridates, prince of the Bosporus, ; .
